verdict.rationale: Intel's first-party developer pages name official SDKs and toolkits that explicitly target Core Ultra series 2: oneAPI/oneDNN with PyTorch optimizations for LLM and image-generation inference, VTune Profiler for client GPU/NPU analysis, and the DPC++ CUDA-to-SYCL migration tool. The spec sheet also lists OpenVINO, WindowsML, DirectML, ONNX RT and WebNN as supported frameworks. Missing for 10: in-depth API/SDK documentation beyond overview-level marketing lines, and independent or hands-on corroboration of building against these SDKs on the 285K.
